 Frank Lampard handed Coventry City boost as Matt Grimes decision made
 Frank Lampard has been boosted by the return of Bobby Thomas for today's game with Thomas Frank's Eagles.
 City's Matt Grimes starts against Crystal Palace
 Add to preferred sources Comments Sport Brian Dick Coventry City Correspondent 13:45, 21 Nov 2026 Updated 14:00, 21 Nov 2026 Frank Lampard has made two changes to his Coventry City starting line-up as Matt Grimes returns as captain.
 The midfielder comes in for Caleb Yirenkyi, who misses out after picking up a knock on international duty and will resume the captaincy alongside Victor Torp in the middle of the park.
 In his pre-match interview Lampard confirmed Yirenkyi had been injured with Ghana.
 The other change from the side that started at Everton comes at the back where Bobby Thomas returns, with Stephen Mfuni moving to left back in place of Jay Dasilva.
 ‌ 
 Thomas partners Ethan Pinnock at the heart of the back four that also features Milan van Ewijk.
 Sign-up to the new Play Up Sky Blues Premium newsletter from Brian Dick 
 Tatsuhiro Sakamoto and Yann Gboho retain their spots on the wing, despite Sakamoto’s exertions in two appearances with Japan.
 ‌ 
 Taiwo Awoniyi remains up front having played in one game for Ghana during the international break.
 SKY BLUES (4-2-3-1): Rushworth; van Ewijk, Thomas, Pinnock, Mfuni; Grimes, Torp; Sakamoto, Rudoni, Gboho; Awoniyi. Subs: Bentley, Dasilva, Simms, Onyeka, Tchaouna, Kesler-Hayden, Thomas-Asante, Hamer, Cherif
